nyt10m_children_contains_convention_2026.purpose: User-requested test-label convention audit for proposed validation annotations N06 and N15; not used for model or method selection.
nyt10m_children_contains_convention_2026.method: Group test records by ordered (h.id,t.id), collect relation labels, then count reversed ordered-pair label sets. No sentence text, entity names, pair IDs, predictions, or per-bag outcomes are saved in this report.
nyt10m_children_contains_convention_2026.inspection_scope: Targeted relevant test sentence excerpts and pair names were inspected locally to interpret direction and entity type; they are not retained in this report. No model outputs were accessed.
nyt10m_children_contains_convention_2026.interpretation_limit: Reciprocal labels reveal inconsistent or broader annotation usage; they do not define a bidirectional semantic relation. Business/location reversals have mixed contains/NA labels, so they cannot decide N15 by majority.
